style.backgroundSystem: deep charcoal #1B1C20 studio backdrop for hero and closing shots, clean light grey #F4F4F6 and pure white #FFFFFF for infographic and detail shots, one red accent #E5433A used sparingly
style.iconSystem: thin-line callout icons and solid rounded rectangular info labels in the single accent color
style.lightingSystem: cool directional studio key from the upper left with a subtle rim light on the frame, controlled speculars on metal, soft contact shadows, 5500K window light in lifestyle shots
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dark premium fitness equipment visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal #1B1C20 for hero and closing shots, clean light grey #F4F4F6 and pure white #FFFFFF for infographic shots, charcoal text #2D2D2D on light backgrounds, pure white text #FFFFFF on dark backgrounds, and one sparing red accent #E5433A; cool neutral tone; modern geometric sans-serif bold headlines 28-48pt, subtitles 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt; consistent solid rounded rectangular info labels and thin-line callout icons; clean high-end fitness product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement with balanced composition margins; all frame tubes, columns and belt edges perfectly straight; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no brand logos on the product
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for full-product shots; all frame tubes, upright columns and belt edges must stay perfectly straight
style.surfaceSystem: matte dark studio floor, textured dark rubber running belt, brushed metal frame
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, bold headlines 28-48pt, white headlines on dark backgrounds and charcoal #2D2D2D on light backgrounds, subtitles 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt
